description: Helper functions for converting between ADODB recordset objects and XMLRPC values, including functions to build XMLRPC structs from recordsets and vice versa.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval
methods.description: Converts an ADODB recordset into an XMLRPC struct value.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_header
methods.description: Creates an XMLRPC struct describing the recordset's metadata.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_body
methods.description: Creates an XMLRPC struct containing the data rows of the recordset.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcstring
methods.description: Serializes the XMLRPC struct of a recordset into a string.

methods.name: xmlrpcval2rs
methods.description: Converts an XMLRPC struct back into an ADODB recordset object.
